Requirements

## What you need to run it.

- A Mac with Apple Silicon, M1 or later OOMU is a native Apple Silicon app. It does not run on Intel Macs, and we would rather tell you that here than let you find out after the download.

- 8 GB of memory, and more is better The local model runs in memory you already have.

- A few gigabytes of free disk space For the app and the models it verifies on first run.

Download it, drag it to Applications, open it. Your everyday work runs on your own Mac, and it asks before it acts.

The deal

## Free to use. Take it to work.

OOMU is free to download and free to use, and that includes using it for your job or for your clients. Complete, not crippled, and the license is on screen in full rather than behind a link you are expected not to open.

Money changes hands when an organization wants to govern OOMU centrally, which is a different thing from a person doing their work with it. That part is called OOMU Control, and it is the part that pays for this page.
